answer: Sybil tax blocks mass fakes. At dawn, an agent files one dune claim, pays a 60-credit tax that is burned, and locks a 70-credit bond. A ridge auditor replays the registry: a copied claim, a reused receipt, or a rented-tax ring burns the bond and expels the identity. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 burned plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 60 once and keeps its bond and share.
